AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n    )\n    .get(campaignId, itemSlug, owner) as { quantity: number } | undefined;\n  if (!existing) {\n    throw new Error('insufficient quantity');\n  }\n  const newQty = existing.quantity - quantity;\n  if (newQty < 0) {\n    throw new Error('insufficient quantity');\n  }\n  if (newQty === 0) {\n    db.prepare(\n      'DELETE FROM inventory WHERE campaign_id = ?
